ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio of high-intensity pixels to low-intensity pixels; approximately 90% low-intensity (black/dark grey) and 10% high-intensity (white/light grey) across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity black field with localized high-intensity white clusters: a medium-sized irregular patch in the lower central region near the fluke base, and small, scattered focal spots primarily on the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with a deep bounding-box depth relative to the vertical lobe axis and a narrow interior pixel angle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serration map; characterized by irregular saw-tooth peaks and deep valleys along the entire linear boundary of both lobes, particularly prominent on the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong concave curve fitting from the median notch extending upward toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extreme concentrations of high-contrast, roughly circular white pixel clusters (barnacles) located at the outer distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous distinct, unaligned white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) scattered across the dark pigmentation of both lobes, with higher density visible on the lower-left quadrant.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake mark scarring across the ventral surface and heavy barnacle colonization at the fluke tips creating irregular textural boundaries.
